_provenance: NYC traffic-accident CAR data, contiguous sub-map (1000 tracts, 2742 induced undirected edges). Source: posteriordb data set `traffic_accident_nyc` (posterior `traffic_accident_nyc-bym2_offset_only`), file posterior_database/data/data/traffic_accident_nyc.json.zip from the local posteriordb checkout at /mnt/sbrantq/probprog/posteriordb, which carries N=1921 tracts, N_edges=5461 undirected adjacency edges (1-based node1/node2 lists), observed accident counts y and exposure E. Sub-map rule: deterministic breadth-first search from tract 0 (0-based), neighbours expanded in ascending node-id order, stopped at 1000 distinct tracts; ids sorted ascending, induced subgraph kept. y and E are the observed values, unmodified; nothing is simulated. Same source and same rule as nyc_traffic_submap.json (the n=250 row of the SICM ablation figure), only the stopping size differs.
